title: Standing wood torch

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Standing wood torch is a light source.
It can hold up to four Resin at once. With 1/4 fuel, a standing wood torch will last for 2 hours and 46 minutes. At maximum capacity, a standing wood torch should burn for 11 hours and 06 minutes.
